translations.b0488: Part 17  Upholding and Improving “One Country, Two Systems” and Advancing National Reunification
translations.b0489: China will unswervingly safeguard and promote the long-term prosperity and stability of Hong Kong and Macao, unswervingly advance the great cause of national reunification, and join hands to create a great undertaking of national rejuvenation.
translations.b0490: Chapter 59  Promoting the Long-Term Prosperity and Stability of Hong Kong and Macao
translations.b0491: China will unswervingly implement the policy of “One Country, Two Systems”, “Hong Kong people governing Hong Kong”, “Macao people governing Macao” and a high degree of autonomy, apply the principles of “patriots administering Hong Kong” and “patriots administering Macao”, improve the effectiveness of law-based governance in Hong Kong and Macao, promote their economic and social development, and give full play to their unique strengths and important role as regions backed by the motherland and connected to the world.
translations.b0492: Section 1  Supporting Hong Kong and Macao in Consolidating and Enhancing Their Competitive Advantages
translations.b0493: China will support Hong Kong in consolidating and enhancing its status as an international financial, shipping and trade center and an international aviation hub, strengthening its functions as a global hub for offshore RMB business, an international asset and wealth management center and an international risk management center, and building a commodity trading ecosystem and a high value-added supply chain services center. It will support Hong Kong in building an international innovation and technology center, in deepening the development of a center for international legal and dispute resolution services, a regional intellectual property trading center and a center for cultural and artistic exchanges between China and other countries, and in accelerating the building of the Northern Metropolis. It will support Macao in pursuing appropriate economic diversification and in deepening its development as a world center of tourism and leisure, a commercial and trade cooperation service platform between China and Portuguese-speaking countries, and a base for exchange and cooperation where Chinese culture is the mainstream and diverse cultures coexist, and in enhancing the competitiveness of industries such as traditional Chinese medicine and health, specialized finance, high technology, and conventions, exhibitions and trade. It will also support Hong Kong and Macao in creating a high ground for attracting high-caliber talent from around the world.
translations.b0494: Section 2  Supporting Hong Kong and Macao in Better Integrating into and Serving the Country’s Overall Development
translations.b0495: Cooperation between Hong Kong and Macao and the mainland in the economic, trade, scientific and technological, cultural and people-to-people fields will be strengthened, and policies and measures will be improved to facilitate the development and daily life of Hong Kong and Macao residents on the mainland. Connectivity between their financial markets and those of the mainland will be advanced in an orderly manner, and collaborative innovation with the mainland among enterprises, universities and research institutes will be deepened. Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao cooperation will be deepened; sustained efforts will be made to achieve breakthroughs in cooperation in key areas; the coordinated development of ports, airports and rail transit will be promoted; the Guangzhou-Zhuhai (Macao) high-speed railway will be built; and preliminary work on the Hong Kong-Shenzhen Western Railway will be advanced. The integrated development of Hengqin and Macao will be deepened, and major cooperation platforms such as Qianhai, Nansha and Hetao will be built to a high standard. The Hengqin forward cargo station of Macao International Airport will be built, the construction of the Macao-Hengqin International Education (University) City will be advanced, and Macao higher education institutions will be supported in extending their operations to Hengqin. Mechanisms for Hong Kong and Macao to better play their role in China’s opening up will be improved; Hong Kong and Macao will be supported in deeply participating in high-quality Belt and Road cooperation and in leveraging their strengths in professional services to help enterprises “go global”; and Hong Kong and Macao will play their important role as a window for exchanges and mutual learning between Chinese and Western civilizations.
translations.b0496: Chapter 60  Promoting the Peaceful Development of Cross-Strait Relations and Advancing the Great Cause of National Reunification
translations.b0497: China will thoroughly implement the Party’s overall policy for resolving the Taiwan question in the new era, uphold the one-China principle and the 1992 Consensus, resolutely strike at “Taiwan independence” separatist forces, oppose interference by external forces, maintain peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait, firmly grasp the initiative and dominance in cross-Strait relations, improve the wellbeing of compatriots on both sides of the Taiwan Strait, and firmly safeguard the common homeland of the Chinese nation.
translations.b0499: China will continue to introduce and implement policies and measures that benefit Taiwan compatriots and Taiwan-funded enterprises, and guide them in actively integrating into and contributing to the building of a new development paradigm. Taiwan-funded enterprises will be supported in putting down roots and developing on the mainland, and in participating in national regional development strategies and Belt and Road cooperation; industrial cooperation will be strengthened to build a cross-Strait common market. It will support Fujian in building, to a high standard, a demonstration zone for cross-Strait integrated development, and advance the building of key cross-Strait cooperation platforms such as Pingtan, Kunshan and Dongguan and of cross-Strait industrial cooperation zones. It will also support the development of a multi-tiered cross-Strait financial market and encourage qualified Taiwan-funded enterprises to list on the mainland.
translations.b0501: The systems and policies for promoting cross-Strait economic and cultural exchanges and cooperation will be improved, personnel exchanges across the Strait will be expanded, and exchanges, interactions and integration between the two sides will be promoted. Cooperation between the two sides in education, healthcare and other fields will be deepened, and social security and public resources will be shared. Cultural exchanges across the Strait will be promoted, Chinese culture will be jointly carried forward and promoted, and Taiwan compatriots’ identification with the Chinese nation, with Chinese culture and with the country will be enhanced. Exchanges between young people and at the grassroots level will be strengthened, and better conditions will continue to be created for young people from Taiwan to pursue, build and realize their dreams on the mainland. The policy of according Taiwan compatriots equal treatment will be implemented, and better conditions will be created for Taiwan compatriots studying, working and living on the mainland. China will unite with the broad masses of Taiwan compatriots to create enduring wellbeing for the Chinese nation.
